provenance.instrument: South Park Township Zoning Ordinance (Chapter 137 Zoning, Ord. No. 556 of 9-16-1996, as amended), as published on eCode360
provenance.status_detail: eCode360 SO0738, Township of South Park, Allegheny County. Chapter 137 was adopted 9-16-1996 by Ord. No. 556 and amended through Ord. No. 648 (2009) and later ordinances, most recently Ord. No. 712 (2023) and 715 (2024) on the residential districts and planned residential developments. New Laws: none listed. The use tables (Attachments 5 and 6, Tables A and B) are PDF attachments that were not opened. Each district article lists its authorized uses in the text, and those lists were read
checks: The zoning chapter has no accessory dwelling unit, in-law suite or similar use
'In the R-1, R-2, R-3, R-4, R-5, RP, BP and CR Districts, any use not specifically listed in the authorized uses for the zoning district shall not be permitted in that zoning district' (137-13A)

'In all zoning districts, single-family dwellings and two-family dwellings shall be the only principal structure on a lot' (137-13C). A single-family detached dwelling contains 'one dwelling unit' (137-9)
No district lists a two-family dwelling as such. Two-family dwellings appear only inside an R-3 planned residential development of at least 10 acres (137-121B(2))
A private garage or storage building over 600 sq ft needs a special exception, and such a building may not be used 'for any dwelling purposes' (137-131A(3)(d))

Accessory structures stay out of the required front and side yards, at least 10 ft from the rear line in R-1 and R-2 (5 ft in R-3 and R-4), and a detached one at least 10 ft from any principal building. Garages and carports stand in a side or rear yard, at least 10 ft from the side and rear lines (137-135C(8), (9))
Off-street parking: two spaces per single-family dwelling unit, three per two-family dwelling unit (137-149C)

In C-1 to C-4, I-1 and I-2 the Zoning Hearing Board may approve a use comparable to the listed uses by special exception, but a use listed in a less restrictive district is not eligible (137-13A, 137-131A(12)). CR and BP list the same special exception although 137-13A says unlisted uses are not permitted there
Any lot of record when the chapter took effect may hold a single-family dwelling or its accessory structure without a lot area or width variance (137-161A)
No section read bars a use variance. Variances need the five findings of 137-166A
provenance.notes: Zoning office: South Park Township. Read in a browser on eCode360, one page at a time, on 2026-11-15, in print view. Searched the code (scope all) for accessory dwelling, in-law, accessory apartment, accessory suite, ECHO, elder cottage, granny, guest house, carriage house, tenant house, living quarters, second dwelling, conversion, two-family, caretaker, farm dwelling, relative and servants. Hits were the dwelling and two-family definitions, 137-13C, the motel definition (resident manager quarters), the family definition (domestic servants) and the subdivision chapter. Read: Article III, the district articles IV to XVII (R-1, R-2, R-3, R-4, R-5, RP, C-1, C-2, C-3, C-4, CR, BP, I-1, I-2), 137-121 (PRD uses), Article XX (137-132 to 137-146), 137-149 (parking), Article XXIII (nonconforming) and 137-166 (variances). Read in part: Article II definitions (A to N in full, the rest by search), Article XIX (137-128 to 137-131A(14). The rest, including 137-131A(22) townhouses and (35) watchman's facility, was not read) and Article XXVII TOOD overlay (137-195 to 137-197 only). Not read: Article I, Article XVIII beyond 137-121, Article XXII (signs), XXV (administration), XXVI (incinerators) and the PDF attachments (Tables A and B, the TOOD master plan, the zoning map). Height is measured to the highest point of the roof from the average finished grade at the front. The TOOD overlay is a master-planned development approved by conditional use (137-196).

term.note: Searched the code for accessory dwelling, in-law, accessory apartment, accessory suite, ECHO, elder cottage, granny, guest house, carriage house, tenant house, living quarters, second dwelling, conversion, two-family, caretaker, farm dwelling, relative and servants, and read every district's use list. No ADU use

status.note: No district lists a second dwelling unit on a house lot. In the residential districts, RP, BP and CR any use not listed is not permitted (137-13A). A house holds one dwelling unit (137-9)

path.note: A second unit is not a listed use, and in R-1, R-2, R-3 and CR unlisted uses are not permitted. The Zoning Hearing Board hears variances on the five findings of 137-166A. No section read bars a use variance

unlisted_use_path.note: In C-1, C-2, C-3, C-4, I-1 and I-2 the Zoning Hearing Board may approve a use 'of the same general character' as the district's listed uses whose impact is no greater. 'If a use is specifically listed in a less restrictive zoning district, it shall not be eligible for consideration as a comparable use in a more restrictive zoning district.' None of these districts lists a house. C-1 and C-3 list an apartment above office or retail (see that alternative). A two-family dwelling is a listed use only inside an R-3 planned residential development (see that alternative), not an unlisted one

unlisted_use_districts.note: 137-13A names these districts. CR and BP also list 'Comparable uses not specifically listed in this district' (137-88C(1)(b), 137-95C(1)(d)), though 137-13A says unlisted uses are not permitted in them

unlisted_use_scope.quote: Uses of the same general character as any of the uses authorized as permitted uses by right, conditional uses or uses by special exception in the zoning district in which the property is located

value.name: Apartment above office or retail (C-1, C-3)
value.conditions: 'A dwelling unit located above the street floor and in the same building with an office or retail establishment' (137-9). Not on the street floor, at least 800 sq ft of habitable floor area, a separate entrance not through the office or retail space, 1.5 off-street spaces per unit with at least two, no shared parking. 'Dwelling units in basements or accessory garages shall not be permitted' (137-131A(2)). C-1 lot 7,500 sq ft, C-3 lot 7,500 sq ft
value.note: The host is an office or retail building, not a house. A special exception from the Zoning Hearing Board

value.name: Two-family dwellings in an R-3 planned residential development
value.conditions: 'In the R-3 District, a PRD may include one or more of the following uses: (a) Single-family detached dwellings and single-family attached dwellings. (b) Two-family dwellings. (c) Townhouses.' A site of at least 10 acres controlled by the developer, public water and sewer, at least 25% common open space, conditional use approval by the Board of Supervisors (137-31B(1)(h), 137-121). A two-family dwelling needs three off-street spaces per unit (137-149C)
value.note: A development of a whole tract, not a change to one house lot. In R-2 a PRD may hold only single-family detached dwellings (137-121B(1))

districts_read_no_listing.note: R-1, R-2 and R-3 permit single-family detached dwellings and group homes, CR single-family dwellings. R-4 permits townhouses and garden apartments on five acres, R-5 mobile home parks by conditional use. C-1 and C-3 permit an apartment above office or retail by special exception, C-3 townhouses or garden apartments by conditional use. RP, C-2, C-4, BP, I-1 and I-2 permit no dwelling, I-1 and I-2 a watchman's facility by special exception

types_allowed.note: No ADU use. A garage or storage building over 600 sq ft may not be used for any dwelling purposes (137-131A(3)(d))

accessory_structure_threshold_sqft.note: Private garages and accessory storage buildings up to 600 sq ft of gross floor area are permitted. Larger ones need a special exception, and then all accessory structures may cover at most 35% of the rear yard

value.where: garages and carports accessory to a single-family or two-family dwelling: in a side or rear yard only, at least 10 ft from the side and rear lines. A detached garage may be joined to the house by walls or a breezeway
any detached accessory structure: at least 10 ft from any principal building, and not in the required front or side yards

spaces_required.note: No ADU use. Single-family dwelling: 2 spaces per dwelling unit. Two-family dwellings: 3 spaces per dwelling unit
